The Makita DSS611Z LXT circular saw comes with a durable 16-tooth TCT blade for precision cutting across plywood, MDF and timber, and bevel cuts of up to 50°. The guide rule gives an accurate finish to parallel cuts and the tool's light weight of 3.1kg and soft-grip handle make it comfortable to use even on long jobs. Safety features include a spindle lock and riving knife to prevent kickback while cutting. The Makita DSS611Z is compatible with all Makita 18V LXT lithium batteries.
